protocols.title: Post-TKR Pain Management
protocols.content: Supra Ortho uses Paracetamol 650mg QDS as first-line post-TKR. Escalate to Tramadol 50mg if VAS > 6. AVOID NSAIDs at all steps due to surgical bleeding risk.

protocols.title: DVT Prophylaxis
protocols.content: ALL ortho surgical patients receive DVT prophylaxis: Enoxaparin 40mg SC daily starting 12 hours post-op. Duration: 14 days for TKR, 28 days for THR.

protocols.title: Sepsis Protocol v3
protocols.content: Supra Sepsis Bundle v3 2026: blood cultures before antibiotics, lactate within 1 HOUR (tightened from v2 which was 3 hours), 30mL/kg crystalloid for hypotension, vasopressors if MAP <65 after fluids.

protocols.title: TKR Discharge Rule
protocols.content: Do NOT discharge TKR patients before 48 hours post-op. Past incident: patient discharged at 36 hours developed DVT at home, emergency readmission.

protocols.title: Warfarin-NSAID Interaction
protocols.content: CRITICAL: Never prescribe NSAIDs to patients on Warfarin. Risk of life-threatening GI bleed. Use Paracetamol for pain.

protocols.title: Diabetic Fasting Protocol
protocols.content: For fasting patients with Type 2 DM: adjust insulin timing not dose. Skip Glimepiride on fast days, continue Metformin with evening meal.

protocols.title: Verbal Orders Policy
protocols.content: NEVER accept verbal orders for medication changes without written confirmation within 1 hour. Exception: cardiac arrest only. Incident 2023: wrong dose from mishearing.

protocols.title: Night Shift Handover
protocols.content: 15-minute structured handover using SBAR format. Include: pending labs, new admissions past 4 hours, patients for morning surgery.
